claim: On AWS Outposts, gp3 volumes support sizes up to 16 TiB, IOPS up to 16,000, and throughput up to 1,000 MiB/s.
question: What size, IOPS and throughput limits apply to gp3 volumes on Outposts?

values.spoken: up to one thousand mebibytes per second
